text:
maria: Heads up — saw a 3x jump in inter-region egress this month, ~7k USD/day increase. Looks correlated with checkpoint syncs and trace uploads.
ops-bot: [alert] Billing anomaly detected for project:redwood-inference — egress spike +312% (2026-06-12 03:02 UTC).
kevin: I pulled flow logs, there's a ton of GET/PUT between eu-west-1 <-> us-west-2 starting 2026-06-09. Top key prefix: checkpoints/training/* and traces/archiver/*.
ali: checking archiver config now. quick grep shows ARCHIVE_S3_REGION=us-west-2 in training-prod helm values for deploy/checkpoint-archiver. That looks wrong — should be eu-west-1.
trevor: I remember a canary change last week that set region override for a test. If archiver wrote to us-west-2 and serving clusters in eu pull latest, that creates cross-region egress on read.
maria: Can we stop the archiver writes to us-west-2 immediately? Prefer a quick block vs waiting for full rollback.
kevin: Doing temporary env unset: `kubectl -n training set env deploy/checkpoint-archiver ARCHIVE_S3_REGION- --record`
kevin: Also added a temp S3 bucket policy to reject writes from training VPCs to the us-west-2 bucket. Policy snippet I applied: ```Condition: { StringNotEquals: { "aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-12345" } }``` 
ali: Finance numbers — finance-ops posted an invoice link: https://billing.example.com/teams/infra/egress-2026 showing ~208k USD incremental for the month; most of it cross-region transfers for model checkpoints and trace archives.
finance-ops: Confirmed ~205k extra. Breakdown: eu->us ~120k, apac->eu ~60k, misc ~25k. This is outside our committed bandwidth assumptions.
maria: Action items: 1) block wrong-region writes (in progress) 2) patch helm charts to correct ARCHIVE_S3_REGION 3) migrate misrouted artifacts into eu bucket via same-region copy 4) add per-region billing alert + dashboard.
trevor: For longer term we should serve artifacts via signed presigned URLs proxied through eu CDN or use a replication pattern that avoids read-time cross-region egress by copying replicas into the consumer region.
kevin: Opened INFRA-4123 with details, runbook, and owners (kevin, ali). Added timeline + estimated cost delta.
ali: Quick scan found 3 CI jobs that set ARCHIVE_S3_REGION in the pipeline: `rg "ARCHIVE_S3_REGION" --hidden ci/ | wc -l` -> 3 matches. I'll patch them.
maria: Finance wants a justified timeline for refund dispute; can we prove misrouting was due to our config change within the dispute window?
finance-ops: If we can show a misconfiguration causing writes to the wrong region and it happened within 30 days, we'll open a provider dispute. Send audit logs + diffs.
kevin: Patch deployed, temp bucket policy in place, and I kicked a migration job to copy recent checkpoints to eu bucket using same-region copy (avoids further cross-region egress). Monitoring should show the egress drop within ~10m.
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollout complete: checkpoint-archiver v2.1.4 -> v2.1.5 by kevin at 2026-06-12T04:15:02Z :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks all. Please update INFRA-4123 with final billing numbers and migration status. We'll sync with finance after we have the first 24h post-fix numbers.
